title: Programs call psionic operators 'pink assets'

tellings.quote: And granted, that is something that has been communicated to me is yes, that some of the programs refer to them as that.

plain: Some secret government UFO programs are said to call their "psionic operators", people who are supposed to use mental abilities to reach or guide unknown craft, by the nickname "pink assets." Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels in 2025 that this was "communicated to me" by a man named Jake Barber, who has made his own claims about these programs. If true, it would mean such programs treat mind abilities as a real working tool.
